aboutHtml:
We're the STIHL stockist for Christchurch and the wider region. Will Price founded STIHL SHOP Northwood on the principle that customers deserve straightforward service, genuine parts, and people who truly understand the equipment and how to look after it.

We sell STIHL chainsaws, brushcutters, trimmers, and blowers for gardens, farms, and small crews. We handle servicing, repairs, and ongoing maintenance. We stock genuine parts and offer practical advice based on real experience. We can set you up with the right equipment for your job and keep you running well.

Come in and talk to us. We're open most days of the week, and we'll help you find what you need, sort out any repairs, or just give you good advice.
servicesIntro: We service and repair STIHL equipment in our workshop.
